messages:
nina patel: Quick sync  we discovered a mismatch in some older code samples that still use `client.models.createCompletion`. Need quick sweep. I can take the Ruby/Go examples.
max chen: I'll sweep JS/TS and the CLI samples. Noting that we should show the new pattern: `await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-v2', input: '...' })`.
olivia park: Adding a micro-postmortem note: a handful of legacy PRs slipped through due to an old template. I'll update the docs PR template to include a checkbox for v1->v2 snippet checks.
ci-bot: docs-ci: PR #4099 (fix/snippets/legacy-completions) opened by @nina  lint ok.
nina patel: Thanks. Also adding a tiny migration blurb under "Client changes" explaining how to enable the compat shim: `new RedwoodClient({ legacyCompat: true })` and when to remove it.
max chen: FYI SDK team will leave the shim for 90 days post-public-announcement. We'll log a warning on first use: `console.warn('legacyCompat is deprecated and will be removed...')`.
olivia park: When you push the PRs, please tag @doc-owners so we can get fast reviews. Also adding a changelog entry stub in the docs repo.
nina patel: Will do. I'll post back once the Ruby/Go updates are merged.
